summary: This Form 6-K is a routine report of foreign private issuer disclosing results of the 2026 Annual General Meeting held on May 15, 2026. The filing announces the election and re-election of five Supervisory Board members: Jonathan D. Klein, Anne Ooga Eriksson, Hassanein Hiridjee, Benjamin T. Faw, and Dr. Akinwumi Ayodeji Adesina. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, going-private transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, spin-off, rights offering, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is involved. This is an ordinary governance update with no special-situation structural or economic terms to analyze. No deal terms are stated.
